verdict.rationale: Deel's founders page says it helps founders "secure the right visa or green card" and lists O-1A alongside EB-2NIW and EB1-A, so the green-card categories are part of its own offering. Nothing documents a strategy for moving from the O-1 to EB-1A or EB-2 NIW, so the 'path, not a dead end' framing is only implied by the list. Missing for 10: documented O-1-to-green-card transition strategy or guidance, detail on EB-1A/NIW petition approach (timing, evidence reuse, concurrent filing), independent or hands-on corroboration of green-card execution.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: We have the immigration experience and know-how to help founders secure the right visa or green card for them. O-1A EB-2NIW EB1-A L-1 E-2 H-1B
